words.text: Oyun ilerlemeni, cüzdanını (satın aldığın altın dahil), ayarlarını ve oynadığın denemelerin kayıtlarını yalnızca bu telefonda tutar. Sunucumuz yoktur; bunların bizde bir kopyası olmaz.

words.note: Privacy card, paragraph 4 (approved text: keep every fact).

words.text: Satın alma altyapısı Unity’nindir. Her satın alma denemesinde Unity’ye ürün, fiyat, mağazanın fişi, telefonunun modeli ve dili, iPhone ve iPad’de de Apple’ın cihaza verdiği uygulama kimliği gider. Unity bunları kendi mali kayıtları, yasal yükümlülükleri ve sahtekârlığı önlemek için kullanır. Bu gönderim kapatılamaz.
words.note: Privacy card, the paragraph on Unity's purchase events (draft of 2026-10-24 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Aptabase, Unity, Google Play and App Store are names).

words.text: İzin verirsen oyun, Aptabase adlı ölçüm hizmetine nasıl oynandığını anlatan kısa notlar gönderir: oyunun açılması, oynadığın bölüm, kazanıp kazanmadığın ve kaç hamle kaldığı, tamamladığın tablo ve oda, mağazanın açılması ve mağazada ne aldığın (ödeme bilgisi olmadan). Her notta zamanı ve yalnızca o oturuma ait rastgele bir numara olur; oyunun sürümü, telefonunun işletim sistemi ve dili de gider. Aptabase notları Avrupa Birliği’nde sayar; bağlantının IP adresinden yaklaşık konumunu (ülke ve bölge) çıkarır ve IP adresini saklamaz.
words.note: Privacy card, the paragraph on the play statistics: what the notes hold and where they go (draft of 2026-10-24 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Aptabase, Unity, Google Play and App Store are names; the list matches PlayNote.cs). Changed 2026-10-25 (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval): says that Aptabase works out the player's approximate location (country and region) from the connection, as the Play Data safety form (Approximate location) and the App Store label (Coarse Location) declare.

words.text: Notlarda adın, e-postan, reklam kimliğin ya da telefonunu tanıyan bir kimlik yoktur. İzin vermezsen oyun aynen çalışır. Kararını Ayarlar’daki Oyun istatistikleri anahtarıyla istediğin zaman değiştirebilirsin.

Shop, in the coins' panel instead of the buttons: the phone's app store (Google Play, App Store) cannot be reached now. Calm, no blame.
Shop, the link under the panels (iPhone and iPad only): asks the App Store for the player's purchases back (Apple's "Restore Purchases").
Name of the smallest coin pack: a pouch of coins.
Name of the second coin pack: a bag of coins.
Name of the third coin pack: a chest of coins.
Name of the largest coin pack: a treasure of coins.
Card before paying, first line: asks whether to buy. {price} is the price as the store writes it in the player's currency ("₺89,99").

words.text: Ödemeyi mağaza alır; satın alma bilgisi Unity’ye de gider.
words.note: Card before paying, second line: the phone's app store takes the payment, and Unity, whose purchase library the game uses, is told of the purchase too.
Card before paying: the green button that opens the store's payment sheet.
Card before paying: the blue button that closes it without paying.
Card while the store takes the payment: its nameplate.
Card while the store takes the payment, first line.
Second line of the cards whose payment is not made yet: what was bought arrives once it is paid.
Card after a payment, first line: the coins arrived. {coins} is the amount.
Card after a payment, second line under the coins.
Card when the payment waits for someone's approval (a parent's "Ask to Buy") or for cash at a shop: its nameplate.
Card when the payment waits for approval, first line.
Card when a purchase came to nothing: its nameplate.
Second line of the card when a purchase came to nothing: no money was taken.
That card, first line: the store cannot be reached now.

words.text: Bu ürün şu anda satışta değil.
words.note: That card, first line: the store does not sell this product now.
That card, first line: the starter pack is sold once and the player has it. {name} is its name.
That card, first line: the store did not take the payment.

words.text: Bunun için bir ödeme zaten bekliyor.
words.note: That card, first line: a payment for this product is waiting already.
Card after asking the store for the purchases back: its nameplate.
That card, first line: the starter pack came back. {name} is its name.

words.text: Geri yüklenecek bir satın alma yok.
words.note: That card, first line: there was nothing to bring back.

words.text: Altın paketleri geri gelmez; yalnız {name} gelir.
words.note: That card, second line: coin packs bought before are not restored, only the starter pack. {name} is its name.
That card, first line: the store did not answer.
That card, second line: try again later.
Build line: things are sold for money through the phone's app store.

Shop, in the coins' panel instead of the buttons: this run of the game cannot keep what it gives (its saved progress could not be read, or a later version of the game wrote it), so nothing is sold until the game is opened again. Calm, no blame, short; one line in the panel (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval).

Card of a payment the store has not answered (the connection to the store was lost while its payment sheet was up, or it has been silent for half a minute), first line: no answer has come yet. Never say that nothing was paid: the payment may still go through, and the second line says it comes once paid (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval).

Entry page, foot, right: the game's version alone, for a build that sells through the phone's app store (no test build). {version} is the version, "1.0" (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's).

Settings card, under the foot: what kind of build this is, for a build that sells through the phone's app store, which is no test build. {ads} is "reklamlar canlandırma" and {buying} "satın alma mağazadan" (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's).

Credits card, a heading: the software the game carries from others (the play statistics' library, the JSON reader, the app stores' purchase libraries); the lines under it stay in English (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval).
